data.name: VSM_001
data.value: This mist is getting thicker...[pause=10] I can barely see anything.

data.name: VSM_002
data.value: Hey, [player]...[pause=10] Does it feel like we're being watched?

data.name: VSM_003
data.value: ...Yeah.[pause=15] For a while now.

data.name: VSM_004
data.value: What the...[pause=0]?!

data.name: VSM_005
data.value: A Pokémon just burst out of the ground!

data.name: VSM_006
data.value: And that one...[pause=15] it was waiting for us.

data.name: VSM_007
data.value: The herd protects its territory...

data.name: VSM_008
data.value: Who...[pause=10] who said that?!

data.name: VSM_009
data.value: It doesn't matter.[pause=20] These creatures will not let you pass without a fight.

data.name: VSM_010
data.value: Show them your resolve...[pause=20] or perish.

data.name: VSM_011
data.value: No choice![pause=10] [player], let's fight!

data.name: VSM_012
data.value: They're still here...[pause=15] We're not losing this time!

data.name: VSM_013
data.value: We did it![pause=10] Those two were tough...

data.name: VSM_014
data.value: But that voice...[pause=15] Who was that?

data.name: VSM_015
data.value: I don't know.[pause=20] Let's keep moving.

data.name: VSM_016
data.value: They disappeared...[pause=15] Come on, let's continue the mission.

data.name: VSM_017
data.value: Not strong enough yet...

data.name: VSM_018
data.value: But you will rise again.[pause=30] They always do.

data.name: VSM_019
data.value: N-no...[pause=10] They're too strong...[pause=15] We have to retreat...

data.name: VSM_020
data.value: Mudbray lets out a triumphant neigh.[pause=15] Stantler lowers its head,[pause=10] antlers still charged.

data.name: VSM_021
data.value: You fought well, little one.[pause=30] But the herd does not fall so easily.

data.name: VSM_022
data.value: The mist envelops them once more...[pause=20] They return to the steppe.

data.name: VSM_023
data.value: Mudbray collapses, groggy.[pause=10] Stantler steps back,[pause=5] its antlers losing their glow.

data.name: VSM_024
data.value: Stantler stares at you for a long moment.[pause=20] Then it bows — a sign of respect.

data.name: VSM_025
data.value: You have earned the right to pass, stranger.[pause=25] The herd will remember you.

data.name: VSM_026
data.value: They retreat into the mist...[pause=15] This time without hostility.

data.name: VSM_027
data.value: We won![pause=10] I can't believe it...

data.name: VSM_028
data.value: The herd protects its own.[pause=20] You would have done the same in their place.

data.name: VSM_029
data.value: Show me what your bond is worth, little emberbearers.

data.name: VSM_030
data.value: That voice... it was watching us. It was TESTING us.

data.name: VSM_031
data.value: Then let's show it what comes next. To the heart of the steppe.

data.name: VSM_032
data.value: Their eyes... they aren't wild. They're organised.

data.name: VSM_033
data.value: The big one hasn't moved. It's letting the other one size us up.

data.name: VSM_034
data.value: You are on their land. They owe you nothing.

data.name: VSM_035
data.value: Then we'll ask for passage. Politely, if we can.

data.name: VSM_036
data.value: Politeness won't work here. Look at them.

data.name: VSM_037
data.value: ...I know. Stay behind me.

data.name: VSM_038
data.value: No. Beside you.

data.name: VSM_039
data.value: The herd shifts. The ground trembles under their hooves.

data.name: VSM_040
data.value: My legs are shaking. I'm not going to pretend otherwise.

data.name: VSM_041
data.value: Mine too. We go anyway.

data.name: VSM_042
data.value: They're stepping back... not fleeing. Withdrawing.

data.name: VSM_043
data.value: We didn't beat them. They decided we'd earned the road.

data.name: VSM_044
data.value: Is there a difference?

data.name: VSM_045
data.value: Out here? All the difference in the world.
